content: «Isra7eele asaappe zarkkefe zarkkefe korapinney issi issi guufe shiishshidi tammanne nam7u guufe immana mala oychcha; histtada issaa issaa sunth he guufeta bolla xaafa.
Lewe zarkketappe shiiqida guufeta bolla Aaroone sunth xaafa; issi issi zarkke kaaleththizaades issi guufey shiiqo.
Heytakka gede Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan efada ta nena haasayssizason Taabotazappe sinththa baggara woththa.
Hessafe guye tani doorizaade guufey purccidi cililana; hessan Isra7eele asay ubba wode ne bolla zuuzumontta mala ta diggana.»

Hessa gishshas Musey hessa Isra7eele asaas yootides; dereza kaallizayti issoy issoy ba guufe guufe ekkidi izas immides; issi zarkke gishshas issi issi guufe gidishin ubbay issi bolla 12 guufey shiiqides; he shiiqida guufeta giddon Aaroone guufey dees.
Musey guufeta ubbaa ekkidi Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza sinththan woththides.
Wonteththa gallas Musey gede Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan gelishin Lewe qommo sunththan shiiqida Aaroone guufeya cililidaaro be7ides; qasseka ciiyada kaxxida ochcholoone ayfe ayfidaaro be7ides.
Museykka guufeta ubbaaka ekki efidi Isra7eele asaa bessides; asaykka hessa ubbaa be7idi issi issi korapinneti ba guufe guufe ekkida.

GODAY Muses, «Aaroone guufeza zaarada Caaqo Qaala Taabotaappe sinththa baggara woththa; makkalliza Isra7eele asay ta bolla zuuzumizayssa aggontta ixxiko istti hayqqanayssa bessiza malata gidi utto» gides.
Museykka GODAY iza azazida mala ooththides.
Isra7eele asay Muses, «Hayssa mala gidikko nuni wurikka wuranaas doos!
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezakko shiiqida asi ubbay hayqqizaa gidikko nunikka wuri hayqqanaas doos guussee?» gides.
